values.note: ReserveAmerica or 1-800-456-2267, up to 9 months ahead, same day included. A 1-night campsite stay can be booked within 3 days of arrival. Maximum 14 continuous nights, then 48 hours away before registering again. The renter must be 18 or older; ID is checked at check-in.

summary: Confirmed on ReserveAmerica (parkId 409): reservable, no hookups (fee note), 2027 season by site range (matches). Added 9-month window, 2-night minimum waived within 3 days, 14-night max, no water/sewer, no dump station, 66 sites to 30 ft, showers (Memorial Day - Labor Day only). Fees left as read 2026-10-12. Note kept. ReserveAmerica shows no closure notice and lists the 2026 season, so no status was written; the inclusion evidence's 2026 bathhouse-construction closure is not mentioned there.
flags: Missing phone: ReserveAmerica's contact section gives only a mailing address (Rte 301, Carmel NY), no park phone; the NY State Parks page (parks.ny.gov, blocks scripted reads) should carry it.
Missing operator website: the entry has only the ReserveAmerica link; add the NY State Parks page (parks.ny.gov/visit/state-parks/clarence-fahnestock-state-park; not opened).
Name: ReserveAmerica publishes 'Clarence Fahnestock State Park' (Clarence Fahnestock Memorial State Park); the entry says 'Fahnestock State Park Campground'.
Minor: listed lengths are short - only 13 of 66 sites at 25-30 ft (30 have no length), so a 23-ft rig must pick carefully.
